entries.en: The seminar compared two fictional reports about human rights.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了两份有关人权的虚构报告。

entries.en: The narrow humpbacked bridge disappeared behind a row of willow trees.
entries.zh: 那座狭窄的驼峰桥隐没在一排柳树后面。

entries.en: The documentary lets a former hunger striker explain his own choices.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片让一位曾经绝食示威的人解释自己的选择。

entries.en: We escaped the hurly-burly of the market through a quiet side street.
entries.zh: 我们穿过一条安静的小街，避开了市场的喧嚣。

entries.en: An empty ice bucket stood beside the unopened bottles.
entries.zh: 一个空冰桶放在未开封的瓶子旁边。

entries.en: The classroom model represented the ice sheet with a thick white layer.
entries.zh: 课堂模型用一层厚厚的白色材料表示冰原。

entries.en: An ice skater waited by the barrier while her coach adjusted the music.
entries.zh: 教练调整音乐时，一名滑冰者在围栏旁等候。

entries.en: The novel's ice-breaker carries mail to an isolated harbour.
entries.zh: 小说中的破冰船把邮件送往一座偏僻港口。

entries.en: We borrowed thicker socks before going ice-skating at the indoor rink.
entries.zh: 去室内冰场滑冰前，我们借了几双厚一些的袜子。

entries.en: The fictional witness describes an identity parade in the final chapter.
entries.zh: 那名虚构证人在最后一章描述了一次嫌疑人列队辨认。

entries.en: The unexplained cancellation caused ill feeling among the volunteers.
entries.zh: 那次未作解释的取消，引起了志愿者们的不满。

entries.en: The novel's thief hides his ill-gotten gains in an abandoned shed.
entries.zh: 小说中的小偷把不义之财藏在一间废弃棚屋里。

entries.en: An urgent letter lay at the bottom of the overflowing in tray.
entries.zh: 一封急信压在塞得满满的收件盘底部。

entries.en: Her in-laws offered to look after the garden during the trip.
entries.zh: 她的姻亲提出，愿意在旅行期间帮忙照看花园。

entries.en: The in-patient asked whether a visitor could bring his reading glasses.
entries.zh: 那位住院病人问，访客能不能把他的老花镜带来。

entries.en: The fictional detective returns to the incident room with a new witness statement.
entries.zh: 那位虚构侦探带着一份新的证人陈述，回到了专案室。

entries.en: The character keeps the income support letters beside her other household papers.
entries.zh: 那个角色把收入保障津贴的信件放在了其他家庭文件旁边。

entries.en: The mock trial examined an allegation of indecent assault.
entries.zh: 模拟审判审查了一项猥亵侵害指控。

entries.en: The exercise asks us to identify the indefinite pronoun in each sentence.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求我们找出每个句子中的不定代词。

entries.en: She wrote each source reference on a separate index card.
entries.zh: 她把每一条来源信息分别写在一张索引卡片上。

entries.en: The exercise compares three imaginary price indices over the same period.
entries.zh: 这道练习比较了同一时期的三个假想价格指数。

entries.en: Our teacher rewrote the sentence as an indirect question.
entries.zh: 老师把那个句子改写成了间接疑问句。

entries.en: The editor replaced the long quotation with a sentence in indirect speech.
entries.zh: 编辑把那段长引文换成了一句间接引语。

entries.en: The lecture examined indirect taxation through a fictional household budget.
entries.zh: 这堂课用一份虚构的家庭预算来分析间接课税。

entries.en: The novel follows workers debating whether to support industrial action.
entries.zh: 这部小说围绕工人们是否支持劳工行动的争论展开。

entries.en: The workshop moved to an industrial estate beyond the railway station.
entries.zh: 那家工坊搬到了火车站另一边的工业区。

entries.en: Poor communication complicated industrial relations at the fictional factory.
entries.zh: 在那家虚构工厂中，沟通不畅让劳资关系变得复杂。

entries.en: The old magazine celebrated the infobahn with unusually optimistic predictions.
entries.zh: 那本旧杂志用格外乐观的预测赞颂信息高速公路。

entries.en: A goal in injury time changed the mood of the entire crowd.
entries.zh: 伤停补时阶段的一个进球，改变了全场观众的情绪。

entries.en: She explained the ins and outs of running the community kitchen.
entries.zh: 她解释了经营社区厨房的各种具体细节。

entries.en: The museum improved the display's interactivity without adding more screens.
entries.zh: 博物馆提高了展品的互动性，却没有增加屏幕。

entries.en: He chose international relations after joining the school's debating society.
entries.zh: 加入学校辩论社后，他选择了国际关系专业。

entries.en: The editor removed the inverted commas around the invented organisation's name.
entries.zh: 编辑去掉了那个虚构组织名称两边的引号。

entries.en: The fictional mayor hoped that inward investment would revive the empty workshops.
entries.zh: 故事中的市长希望外来投资能够让空置的作坊恢复生机。

entries.en: The student compared the issue price with a later price in the fictional example.
entries.zh: 学生比较了虚构案例中的发行价格与后来的价格。

entries.en: The museum's oldest jet aircraft stood beneath a recently repaired roof.
entries.zh: 博物馆里最老的一架喷气式飞机，停在新修好的屋顶下面。

entries.en: An empty jewel case lay open beside the dressing mirror.
entries.zh: 一个空珠宝盒敞开放在梳妆镜旁边。

entries.en: Her new role offered less travel but much greater job satisfaction.
entries.zh: 她的新岗位出差更少，却带来了高得多的工作满足感。

entries.en: The job seeker practised describing her previous work without exaggerating it.
entries.zh: 那位求职者练习介绍以前的工作，注意不夸大。

entries.meaningZh: 优先派给亲友或支持者的美差
entries.en: The residents criticised the appointments as jobs for the boys.
entries.zh: 居民们批评，那些任命是在给自己人安排美差。

entries.meaningZh: 墨守工作规章的人〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The comedy portrays the receptionist as a jobsworth who refuses every small exception.
entries.zh: 那部喜剧把接待员描写成一个墨守规章、连小例外也不肯接受的人。

entries.en: Choosing the final photograph was a judgment call, not a question of arithmetic.
entries.zh: 选择最后那张照片，需要凭判断作决定，而不是靠算术。

entries.en: The exhibition included a model jump jet beside photographs of its cockpit.
entries.zh: 展览中，一架垂直起降喷气机模型旁边摆着驾驶舱照片。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车电瓶跨接电线〔美式英语〕
entries.en: The borrowed jumper cables were still coiled inside the carrying bag.
entries.zh: 借来的汽车电瓶跨接电线还盘在收纳袋里。

entries.en: This narrow brush is just the job for painting the window frame.
entries.zh: 给窗框刷漆，这把窄刷子正好合用。

entries.en: A warm bowl of soup was just the thing after the walk.
entries.zh: 走完那段路后，一碗热汤正是我们想要的。

entries.en: My key card had slipped behind the folded map.
entries.zh: 我的门卡滑到了折好的地图后面。

entries.en: The keyboarder checked each line against the handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 那名键盘输入员对照手写笔记，检查了每一行。

entries.en: The seminar compared different accounts of recovery after keyhole surgery.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了有关微小切口手术后康复的不同叙述。

entries.en: She found a kindred spirit in the neighbour who also restored old furniture.
entries.zh: 那位同样修复旧家具的邻居，让她找到了志趣相投的人。

entries.en: The wedding brought her scattered kith and kin together for a weekend.
entries.zh: 婚礼让她散居各地的亲朋聚在一起，度过了一个周末。

entries.meaningZh: 枪击膝部的暴力伤害行为
entries.en: The documentary examines the long aftermath of kneecapping without showing the attack.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了枪击膝部暴行留下的长期影响，没有展示袭击过程。

entries.meaningZh: 热闹的聚会〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The reunion became a cheerful knees-up after the speeches ended.
entries.zh: 讲话结束后，那场重聚变成了欢乐热闹的聚会。

entries.en: She wrapped the knick-knacks individually before packing the contents of the shelves.
entries.zh: 把架子上的东西装箱前，她先把小摆设逐一包好了。

entries.en: The chef counted the clean knives before putting them away.
entries.zh: 厨师把干净的刀收起来之前，先数了一遍。

entries.en: Another knockback made him rethink the timing of his proposal.
entries.zh: 又一次被拒，让他重新考虑提出提案的时机。

entries.en: The fictional detective notices a knuckle-duster among the confiscated objects.
entries.zh: 那位虚构侦探注意到，没收的物品中有一个指节铜套。

entries.en: The class compared the labour force of two imaginary towns.
entries.zh: 全班比较了两个虚构城镇的劳动力情况。

entries.en: The researcher interviewed graduates about their first experiences of the labour market.
entries.zh: 研究者采访了毕业生，了解他们初入劳动力市场的经历。

entries.en: The new manager hoped that clearer communication would improve labour relations.
entries.zh: 新经理希望，更清楚的沟通能改善劳资关系。

entries.en: His muddy lace-ups stayed outside while the cleaner mopped the hall.
entries.zh: 清洁员拖礼堂地板时，他把沾泥的系带鞋留在了外面。

entries.meaningZh: 多情种；很有异性缘的男子
entries.en: In the comedy, the ageing lady-killer fails to impress his new neighbour.
entries.zh: 喜剧中，那个上了年纪的多情种没能打动新邻居。

entries.en: Someone had tied a lost-dog notice to the lamp-post.
entries.zh: 有人把一张寻狗启事绑在了路灯柱上。

entries.en: The fictional surveyor visits the land registry to examine an old map.
entries.zh: 故事中的测量员到土地登记处查看一张旧地图。

entries.en: We practised listening in the language laboratory after the lecture.
entries.zh: 讲座结束后，我们到语言实验室练习了听力。

entries.en: The collector found the missing laser disc inside the wrong sleeve.
entries.zh: 收藏者在一个装错的封套里找到了那张丢失的激光影碟。

entries.en: The novel's family discovers a sealed last will and testament in the study.
entries.zh: 小说中的一家人在书房里发现了一份密封的遗嘱。

entries.en: He feared that one careless remark would make him a laughing stock.
entries.zh: 他担心，一句不慎的话就会让自己成为笑柄。

entries.en: The meeting began with a laundry list of unfinished repairs.
entries.zh: 会议一开始，就列出了一长串未完成的维修项目。

entries.en: The fictional council debates law and order without agreeing on a single proposal.
entries.zh: 故事中的议会讨论了治安问题，却没能就任何一个提案达成一致。

entries.en: The guide pointed out the old law court beside the market square.
entries.zh: 导游指出了集市广场旁边的旧法院。

entries.en: The novel refuses to present every law-breaker as the same kind of person.
entries.zh: 这部小说没有把每个违法者都刻画成同一种人。

entries.en: The seminar examines law-enforcement through contrasting fictional case studies.
entries.zh: 研讨课通过相互对照的虚构案例，分析执法问题。

entries.en: The lead singer waited until the drummer had adjusted the microphone.
entries.zh: 主唱一直等到鼓手调好麦克风。

entries.en: The lead-up to the festival was dominated by repairs to the hall.
entries.zh: 节庆活动之前的准备阶段，主要都在维修礼堂。

entries.en: The coach pinned the updated league table beside the changing room door.
entries.zh: 教练把更新后的比赛名次表贴在了更衣室门旁。

entries.en: We asked about left luggage before deciding to explore the city.
entries.zh: 决定逛逛这座城市之前，我们先询问了行李寄存的事。

entries.en: The novel's protagonist asks a community adviser about legal aid.
entries.zh: 小说主人公向社区顾问询问了法律援助。

entries.en: The leisure centre lent its main hall to the youth orchestra.
entries.zh: 康乐中心把主礼堂借给了青年管弦乐团。

entries.en: The exercise changes the lending rate while keeping the imaginary loan amount fixed.
entries.zh: 这道练习改变贷款利率，同时让假想的贷款金额保持不变。

entries.en: A brief let-up in the rain allowed us to move the chairs.
entries.zh: 雨短暂减弱了一阵，让我们得以搬动椅子。

entries.en: The fictional publican asks an adviser about the local licensing laws.
entries.zh: 故事中的酒馆老板向顾问询问当地酒类经营许可法律。

entries.en: The interview explores why the character decides to consult a life coach.
entries.zh: 那段访谈探讨了那个角色为什么决定咨询人生教练。

entries.en: A light aircraft waited outside the small hangar.
entries.zh: 一架轻型飞机停在小机库外面。

entries.en: The exhibition compares light industry with the town's older heavy-industry factories.
entries.zh: 这场展览比较了轻工业与镇上更早的重工业工厂。

entries.en: A lightning strike damaged the old tree beside the barn.
entries.zh: 一次雷击损坏了谷仓旁的老树。

entries.en: The village hall offered line dancing on Thursday evenings.
entries.zh: 村礼堂在星期四晚上提供队列舞活动。

entries.en: Her line manager helped arrange a quieter workspace.
entries.zh: 她的直属经理帮她安排了一个更安静的工作位置。

entries.meaningZh: 唱片封套上的说明文字
entries.en: A handwritten correction appeared beside the final liner note.
entries.zh: 最后一段唱片封套说明文字旁边，有一处手写更正。

entries.en: Repairing the roof took the lion's share of the theatre's small budget.
entries.zh: 修屋顶花掉了剧院小额预算中的最大一部分。

entries.en: The classroom case follows a small firm becoming a listed company.
entries.zh: 课堂案例围绕一家小公司成为上市公司的过程展开。

entries.en: The caretaker moved the litter bin away from the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 管理员把垃圾箱从狭窄门口移开了。

entries.en: The survey explored how residents described their own living standard.
entries.zh: 这项调查研究了居民如何描述自己的生活水平。

entries.en: The lock-keeper waved from the small office beside the canal.
entries.zh: 运河水闸管理员从运河旁的小办公室里挥了挥手。

entries.en: The novel's factory owner announces a lock-out before the workers can respond.
entries.zh: 小说中的工厂主宣布停工闭厂，工人们还没来得及回应。

entries.en: The captain's log book contained a sketch of the damaged harbour wall.
entries.zh: 船长的航海日志里有一幅受损港口堤墙的草图。

entries.en: The old magazine included a page of messages from lonely hearts.
entries.zh: 那本旧杂志中有一页征友征婚者的留言。

entries.en: The newcomers hardly got a look-in against the experienced team.
entries.zh: 面对经验丰富的队伍，那些新人几乎没有获胜的机会。

entries.meaningZh: 险损估价师；保险理算人
entries.en: The fictional loss adjuster examines photographs of the damaged shop.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的保险理算人查看了受损店铺的照片。

entries.en: Someone had handed my missing scarf to lost and found.
entries.zh: 有人把我丢失的围巾交到了失物招领处。

entries.en: The caretaker kept the lost property in a cupboard beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 管理员把遗失物放在了入口旁的橱柜里。

entries.en: The comedy turns a borrowed cottage into an unlikely love nest.
entries.zh: 那部喜剧把一间借来的小屋变成了一个出人意料的爱巢。

entries.en: The novel tells the same love triangle through three conflicting accounts.
entries.zh: 这部小说用三种相互矛盾的叙述，讲述了同一段三角恋。

entries.en: She has a love-hate relationship with the old house she inherited.
entries.zh: 她对继承来的那座老房子既爱又恨。

entries.en: The historian questions the novelist's narrow depiction of urban low life.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家质疑小说家对城市社会下层生活的狭隘描写。

entries.en: The guest house closed its upper floor during the low season.
entries.zh: 招待所在淡季关闭了楼上的客房。

entries.en: The label should use lower case except for the first letter.
entries.zh: 除了首字母以外，标签上应该使用小写字母。

entries.en: The teacher asked us to find the lowest common denominator before adding the fractions.
entries.zh: 老师让我们先找出最小公分母，再把分数相加。

entries.en: She found her loyalty card beneath the receipts in her purse.
entries.zh: 她在钱包里的收据下面找到了积分卡。

entries.en: A small apple fitted into the corner of the lunch box.
entries.zh: 一个小苹果正好放进了饭盒的一角。

entries.en: We shared a table beside the crowded lunch counter.
entries.zh: 我们在拥挤的便餐柜台旁与人合用了一张桌子。

entries.en: She used her lunch hour to return the library books.
entries.zh: 她利用午休时间归还了图书馆的书。

entries.meaningZh: 做作的演员〔英式俚语，贬称〕
entries.en: The review rejected the lazy stereotype of the theatrical luvvie.
entries.zh: 那篇评论反对把戏剧演员刻板地描绘成做作的“戏子”。

entries.en: The last serving of macaroni cheese went to the volunteer washing up.
entries.zh: 最后一份芝士通心粉给了那个正在洗碗的志愿者。

entries.en: In the story, the magic carpet refuses to leave without the cat.
entries.zh: 故事中，没有那只猫同行，魔毯就不肯起飞。

entries.en: The stage assistant found the missing magic wand behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 舞台助理在幕布后面找到了丢失的魔杖。

entries.en: The historical novel's major general waits for news at a remote farmhouse.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说中的少将在偏僻农舍里等候消息。

entries.en: The estimate allowed one man-hour for checking each set of drawings.
entries.zh: 那份估算为检查每套图纸预留了一个工时。

entries.en: She added the mangetout to the basket beside the other vegetables.
entries.zh: 她把嫩豌豆放进了篮子，摆在其他蔬菜旁边。

entries.en: The visitors watched the march-past from the edge of the square.
entries.zh: 来宾们在广场边观看了分列式。

entries.en: The student calculated a modest mark-up in the classroom example.
entries.zh: 学生在课堂例题中计算了一个不高的加价幅度。

entries.en: The fictional firm's market share fell despite its increasing sales.
entries.zh: 那家虚构公司的销售额虽然增加，市场占有率却下降了。

entries.en: The bakery postponed the market test until the packaging was ready.
entries.zh: 面包店把市场测试推迟到了包装准备好之后。

entries.en: The students proposed a marketing mix for an imaginary bicycle shop.
entries.zh: 学生们为一家假想自行车店提出了营销组合方案。

entries.en: The novel's couple disagree about whether to seek marriage guidance.
entries.zh: 小说中的夫妇对是否寻求婚姻咨询意见不一。

entries.en: The course examines how the mass media frame everyday events.
entries.zh: 这门课分析大众传播媒体如何呈现日常事件。

entries.en: The old massage parlour's reception desk remained behind the boarded window.
entries.zh: 那家旧按摩院的接待台，还留在被木板封住的窗后。

entries.en: The students compared the two matrices before attempting the multiplication.
entries.zh: 学生们先比较了两个矩阵，再尝试相乘。

entries.en: A mature student in our group balanced evening classes with a full-time job.
entries.zh: 我们组的一位成人学生一边上夜校，一边做全职工作。

entries.en: Workers planted young trees along the median strip.
entries.zh: 工人们沿着公路中央分隔带种下了小树。

entries.en: The megamall's quiet reading corner surprised us after the crowded entrance.
entries.zh: 走过拥挤入口后，超大型购物中心里安静的阅读角让我们感到意外。

entries.en: The photographer kept a spare memory card in a zipped pocket.
entries.zh: 摄影师把一张备用存储卡放在带拉链的口袋里。

entries.en: The merry-making continued in the courtyard after the musicians had packed away.
entries.zh: 乐手们收拾好东西后，院子里的欢庆还在继续。

entries.en: Someone posted a rehearsal timetable on the club's message board.
entries.zh: 有人在俱乐部的留言板上发布了排练时间表。

entries.en: The mice had made a nest behind the abandoned cupboard.
entries.zh: 那些老鼠在废弃橱柜后面筑了窝。

entries.en: Her micro-economics assignment compared two imaginary firms selling the same product.
entries.zh: 她的微观经济学作业比较了两家出售同一种产品的假想公司。

entries.en: The seminar examined microcredit through contrasting fictional borrowing stories.
entries.zh: 研讨课通过相互对照的虚构借贷故事，分析了小额信贷。

entries.en: The label said the soft cloth was made from microfibre.
entries.zh: 标签上写着，这块柔软的布由超细纤维制成。

entries.en: The acrobat caught the ribbon in mid-air.
entries.zh: 杂技演员在半空中接住了彩带。

entries.en: The committee searched for middle ground between the competing plans.
entries.zh: 委员会在相互竞争的方案之间寻找折中立场。

entries.en: The proposed reorganisation worried several people in middle management.
entries.zh: 拟议中的重组让几位中层管理人员感到担忧。

entries.en: The comedy questions whether the character's restlessness is really a midlife crisis.
entries.zh: 那部喜剧探讨了那个角色的躁动是否真的是中年危机。

entries.en: She chose midnight blue rather than black for the stage curtain.
entries.zh: 她为舞台幕布选了深蓝色，而不是黑色。

entries.en: The memoir recalls helping her father with his early milk round.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录追忆了她清晨帮父亲沿固定路线送奶的经历。

entries.en: We planned a mini-break without booking more than two nights away.
entries.zh: 我们计划来个短假，外宿不超过两晚。

entries.meaningZh: 迷你剧；短篇电视连续剧
entries.en: The mini-series follows the same family across three episodes.
entries.zh: 那部迷你剧用三集讲述了同一个家庭的故事。

entries.en: The costume designer shortened the mini-skirt for the dance scene.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为那场舞蹈戏把迷你裙改短了。

entries.en: We spent too long discussing minutiae and never settled the main question.
entries.zh: 我们花太多时间讨论细枝末节，始终没有解决主要问题。

entries.en: The novel gradually reveals the miscarriage of justice behind the conviction.
entries.zh: 这部小说逐渐揭露了那项定罪背后的司法不公。

entries.en: The fictional reporter keeps a photograph of the missing person beside her notes.
entries.zh: 那名虚构记者在笔记旁放着一张失踪者的照片。

entries.en: The volunteers rewrote the mission statement in plain language.
entries.zh: 志愿者们用通俗语言重写了宗旨声明。

entries.en: A case of mistaken identity drives the comedy's opening scene.
entries.zh: 一起认错身份的事件，推动了喜剧开场情节的发展。

entries.en: The club added mixed doubles to its summer tournament.
entries.zh: 俱乐部在夏季锦标赛中增加了混合双打项目。

entries.meaningZh: 现代化生活设备〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The cottage lacked mod cons but had a warm, spacious kitchen.
entries.zh: 那间小屋缺少现代化生活设备，却有个温暖宽敞的厨房。

entries.en: A friendly moggy followed us through the community garden.
entries.zh: 一只友善的家猫跟着我们穿过社区花园。

entries.en: The novel's money-maker struggles to find time for her family.
entries.zh: 小说中，那个善于挣钱的人却很难腾出时间陪伴家人。

entries.en: The monkey bars stood beside a newly painted bench.
entries.zh: 儿童攀爬架旁放着一张新刷过漆的长凳。

entries.meaningZh: 坚定的意志；坚强的品格
entries.en: The story tests the protagonist's moral fibre without giving him an easy answer.
entries.zh: 这个故事考验了主人公的品格，没有给他一个轻松的答案。

entries.en: The narrow defeat still felt like a moral victory to the inexperienced team.
entries.zh: 尽管以微弱差距落败，那支经验不足的队伍仍觉得获得了精神胜利。

entries.en: The bricklayer set the mortar board beside the unfinished wall.
entries.zh: 砌砖工把托灰板放在了尚未完工的墙旁。

entries.en: The carpenter measured the door before replacing the mortise lock.
entries.zh: 木匠先量了门，再更换嵌入式门锁。

entries.en: The mother-to-be asked for a quieter seat during the long meeting.
entries.zh: 那位准妈妈在长时间开会时，请求换到一个更安静的座位。

entries.en: The old motor car appeared in several photographs from the family archive.
entries.zh: 家族档案的几张照片里，都出现了那辆旧汽车。

entries.en: The mouse pad had curled at one corner beneath the keyboard tray.
entries.zh: 键盘托盘下面的鼠标垫，有一个角翘了起来。

entries.en: The debate deteriorated into mud-slinging instead of addressing the proposed repairs.
entries.zh: 辩论变成了相互中伤，没有讨论拟议中的维修。

entries.en: The guide asked us to observe the mudflats from the marked path.
entries.zh: 导游让我们从标明的路径上观察潮泥滩。

entries.meaningZh: 拥有数百万财产的大富翁
entries.en: The comedy's multi-millionaire secretly misses his old neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 那部喜剧里的大富翁暗自怀念着从前的街区。

entries.en: The workshop introduced multi-skilling through several rotating practical tasks.
entries.zh: 工作坊通过几项轮换的实际任务，介绍了多种技能训练。

entries.en: The quiz used multiple choice for its opening questions.
entries.zh: 小测验在开头几道题中采用了多项选择题型。

entries.en: A smudged multiplication sign made the exercise difficult to read.
entries.zh: 一个模糊的乘号让那道练习很难辨读。

entries.en: The child checked the multiplication table before correcting her answer.
entries.zh: 孩子先查看了乘法表，再订正答案。

entries.en: We brought a few munchies for the long evening rehearsal.
entries.zh: 我们为漫长的晚间排练带了一些小点心。

entries.en: The old radio had become a museum piece rather than a household appliance.
entries.zh: 那台旧收音机已经成了老古董，不再是家用电器了。

entries.en: The musical director shortened the introduction before the final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 最后一次排练前，音乐总监缩短了前奏。
